title: Meet sea otters behind the scenes
description: Georgia Aquarium’s Sea Otter Encounter takes you behind the Cold Water Quest habitat with animal-care staff. Learn how the team prepares food, trains the otters, and supports their wellbeing, then meet one of the animals at close range. The experience makes their playful public behavior more interesting by showing the daily care behind it.
teaser: See how aquarium staff care for sea otters.
goodToKnow: The encounter follows animal-care rules; check age and access requirements. Contact with an otter is never guaranteed.
whyItMightDelightYou: The staff’s stories reveal the intelligence and needs behind the otters’ charm.
